## We want to revolutionize Democracy with you

## share your experience!

#### Dear Reader,

We are excited to launch **EuroSense,** an innovative project that builds a European Citizen Sensor Network!

**We want YOU to be part of it!**

Together we can make **democracy more inclusive**. The more **polarised** and **fragmented** European societies become, the harder it is to **unite Europe**. We need to be **innovative and forward-looking.** We need to **bridge social divides** and work towards **common solutions**.

**_But how do we do this?_**

By using **innovative technology** to **make sense of real life experiences**, we can shape **citizen-centred** activism and policy. A **Sense Maker tool** allows us to **collect** thousands of stories, with **context and meaning** provided by citizens themselves. This is a **ground-breaking approach to citizen participation** that only we can deliver on this scale, from the local to the European level. 

Take a **few minutes** of your time to help us shine a light on the **diverse perspectives** that shape our community. **Your story** will contribute to our **collective understanding** and play a vital role in kick-starting this **democratic innovation**.
Encourage your **friends and family** to share their stories too - **let's amplify all voices!**
